purpose: Real Miami transactions between the 2004 draft and the 2004-05 season that move players OUT of Miami to another club. AGENTS.md rule 1 skips every real Miami transaction: a player in one stays with the club that had him before it. The 2004-05 roster file already returns players real Miami acquired to their previous clubs ('returned'); this list names the players real Miami sent away, so the offseason does not move them with history. World data only: never a reason for a simulated decision.

transactions.description: The Los Angeles Lakers traded Shaquille O'Neal to Miami for Caron Butler, Lamar Odom, Brian Grant and a future first-round pick.
